   CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS

LS  POLICY AND MANAGEMENT

  MEMORANDUM

 TO:  City Council Liaison/Rodeo Drive /Special Events /Holiday Program Committee
  (Mayor Friedman and Councilmember Wells)

 FROM:  Nancy Hunt-Coffey, City Manager

 DATE:  November 20, 2024

 SUBJECT:  Comprehensive Review of City Events
 ATTACHMENT:  1. List of Events

At various times, the City Council has expressed a desire to review the comprehensive list of
events offered by the City. Most recently, the City Council provided direction to review the list of
events in light of current and forecasted budget deficits in the upcoming years. Additionally, the
City has been offering and supporting many events for a number of years, and the City Council
has not recently had an opportunity to determine whether they should continue to be offered, or
whether different events should be developed for the community.

Attached is the list of events in which the City currently has some role, including events where the
City is involved in:
  • Planning and carrying out the event (such as Concerts on Canon)
  • Providing some financial support for the event (such as Rodeo Drive Celebrates) and/or
  • Providing staff support to assist with coordinating the event (such as the Milken
  Conference)

The list also includes potential events which have been mentioned by Councilmembers or
community members, such as a possible 4th of July celebration.

Recommendation
The Committee is asked to review the list and provide feedback to staff on whether these events
represent what the City should be offering/supporting. Feedback from the Committee is welcome
on events that should be changed, added, or considered for elimination.
